FAQs

Can they be used on a dimmable switch?

No. Only app/voice dimming. Physical dimmer switches may cause flickering.

Can they dim?

Yes. They're dimmable from 1%–100% via Govee Home App or voice control (Alexa/Google Assistant). Note: Dimmable switches are not supported.

Are these compatible with Govee DreamView?

Yes. They can be synced with DreamView in the app for immersive lighting effects (e.g., matching TV backlights).

Are they compatible with Govee motion sensor/remote?

No. These bulbs do not support Govee's motion sensor or remotes—only app/voice control.
